mapper.sql: SELECT b.no, b.category, b.title, b.text, b.view, b.CREATEDAT, b.UPDATEDAT, m.nickname as writer_nickname, b.writer as writer_id FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer = m.id
mapper.select: WHERE b.category = #{category} ORDER BY b.CREATEDAT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (category, title, text, writer, view, CREATEDAT, UPDATEDAT) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{text}, #{writer}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, text = #{text}, category = #{category}, UPDATEDAT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE no = #{no}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board WHERE no = #{no} AND writer = #{writer}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board WHERE category = #{category}
